{{Top|leg}}
A '''sight visor''' was a special visor worn by [[Defel/Legends|Defels]] when they left their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Af'El/Legends|Af'El]] that allowed them to "see" by blocking out all light wavelengths other than [[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]]. If a Defel lost their sight visor, they were effectively rendered blind.
